coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD and LICENSE files due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (such as HTTP 400) to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts when critical files like the PKGBUILD are skipped.
